description: This PHP class defines the 'TaskSchedulerLog' entity for the OrangeHRM system, representing a log record of scheduled tasks with properties like start time, end time, command, input data, and status. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: TaskSchedulerLog
classes.description: Entity representing a log entry for task scheduling, including timing, command, input, and status.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the log record.

methods.name: setStartedAt
methods.description: Sets the start time of the task.

methods.name: setFinishedAt
methods.description: Sets the finish time of the task.

methods.name: setInput
methods.description: Sets the input data for the task as a key-value array.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status code of the task.
